cards.name: ASA FRADDCO (all rasters, screening fit)
cards.E_status: provisional (generic ASA; not measured in this dataset)

tcd.qualification: least-squares point-method fit to measured SENB failure loads
tcd.note: sigma_uts_MPa here is the fitted inherent strength sigma_0, not the tensile strength; K_Ic is sigma_0 sqrt(pi L), chosen so the tool's L = (K/sigma)^2/pi reproduces the fitted L.

weibull.note: m from within-group load scatter (CoV ~ 1.2/m); S0 least squares on notched groups. Mean-load prediction NOT validated (RMS 25 % on notched SENB): use for scatter / probability of failure only.

cards.use_note: Screening fit for single-edge-notch bend geometry. In these tests a notch-blind constant load per raster fits as well (RMS 12.3 %), so L and sigma_0 are NOT identified as transferable material constants: use for screening, not design. Peak load is weakly notch-sensitive; failure MODE is not (sharper notch and 0/90 raster: more brittle). Calibrated on the bare specimen with imprinted contact strips (roller supports, RBE3 load) -- no added material at the rig contacts.

provenance.dataset: Arrieta, Cicero et al., Notch Effect in ASA: Tensile and Fracture Tests - FRADDCO project
provenance.records: 71 SENB (r = 0, 0.5, 1, 2 mm; one sheet without data) + 9 tensile, 3 rasters
provenance.method: bench/asa_tcd_calibrate.py (contact = strips; one FE model per raster x radius, group-mean geometry) + bench/asa_build_cards.py
provenance.verification: Opus verifier 2026-10-07 (pads calibration): numbers reproduced; flagged non-identifiability
provenance.restrictions: FDM ASA as printed in the source study; raster orientation as named; screening only
